categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily engages in the research, development, production and sales of small modulus gears, precision reducers (harmonic reducers) and related components. The main product categories include steel gears (conical gears, cylindrical gears, spiral bevel gears, etc.), precision reducers and components (harmonic reducers, planetary reducers, micro reducers), pneumatic tools, and new energy transmission products. These products are widely applied in new energy vehicles, industrial robots, smart home devices, medical equipment, electric tools, and other fields.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company's core technologies span the entire product lifecycle including gear and tooth profile R&D design, tool design, CNC milling machine manufacturing, and product testing. The company employs cutting-edge manufacturing processes including precision cutting, hard tooth surface cutting, and powder metallurgy techniques. The company has established advanced production and testing capabilities with world-class equipment including German Klingelnberg P26/P40 gear precision testing machines, Japanese TTI gear measurement centers, and other precision instruments. The company has developed self-designed CNC milling machines to enhance production efficiency and reduce costs.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company's primary customers include major multinational enterprises such as Bosch Group, Stanley Black & Decker, Makita, Techtronic Industries, and TTI. The company serves multiple downstream industries including electric tools (the largest market segment at 24.13% of revenue), smart home devices (46.07% of revenue), precision reducers for robotics (23.56% of revenue), and new energy vehicle transmissions (5.72% of revenue). The company has established long-term stable business relationships with these leading global enterprises and has entered their supply chain systems.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Taizhou, Zhejiang Province. The company has established subsidiaries including Zhejiang Zhonghao Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd., Zhejiang Fengxi Technology Co., Ltd., and overseas subsidiaries Fore Intelligence Germany GmbH (Germany) and FORE INTELLIGENCE (SINGAPORE) PTE. LTD. (Singapore). In 2024, domestic sales accounted for 55.12% of revenue while overseas sales represented 44.88%, indicating significant international market presence.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream to downstream segments of the supply chain. As a precision component manufacturer, the company produces small modulus gears and precision reducers that serve as critical intermediate components for downstream manufacturers of electric tools, smart home devices, robots, and new energy vehicles. The company sources raw materials (steel, forgings, auxiliary materials) from upstream suppliers and sells finished products directly to major OEMs and system integrators.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company's strategic priorities include: (1) Technology innovation and new product development, with R&D investment of 20.65 million yuan in 2024 (4.09% of revenue); (2) Expansion into emerging markets including humanoid robots, new energy vehicles, and smart home applications; (3) Product line extension from core small modulus gears to precision reducers and intelligent drive systems; (4) International market development with overseas subsidiaries in Germany and Singapore; (5) Manufacturing capability enhancement through advanced equipment investment and process optimization. The company has completed development of harmonic reducer products for humanoid robots and is ramping up production capacity.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through direct sales of manufactured products. For small modulus gears, precision reducers and related components, the company employs a direct sales model to major customers. For pneumatic tools, the company uses a distribution/dealer model. Revenue is recognized when products are delivered to customers and control of goods is transferred. The company operates on a 'make-to-order' production model based on customer purchase plans and real-time orders, with payment terms typically 1-4 months after invoice issuance.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading manufacturer in the small modulus gear segment, ranking among the top in China. The company holds the position of Vice Director of the National Small Modulus Gear Working Committee and is recognized as a National 'Little Giant' Enterprise and National Manufacturing Champion Enterprise. Major competitors in the precision reducer market include international suppliers, though the company has established competitive advantages through long-term relationships with leading global OEMs. The company's market position is strengthened by its quality certifications (ISO9001, IATF16949, ISO14001) and recognition as a preferred supplier by major customers including Bosch, Stanley Black & Decker, and Makita.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved consolidated revenue of 504.69 million yuan, representing 17.56% growth compared to 429.32 million yuan in 2023. Net profit attributable to shareholders was 16.80 million yuan in 2024, down 30.28% from 24.09 million yuan in 2023, primarily due to increased depreciation from new equipment, higher personnel costs from business expansion, and R&D investments. Total assets reached 1.31 billion yuan at year-end 2024 (up 7.46% from 1.22 billion yuan in 2023). The company has demonstrated consistent revenue growth with expanding asset base, though profitability declined in 2024 due to strategic investments in new business areas.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company's competitive differentiation is built on: (1) Technical excellence - mastery of precision manufacturing across the entire product lifecycle from design to testing; (2) Quality leadership - strict adherence to international quality standards and long-term partnerships with leading global OEMs; (3) Customization capability - ability to develop tailored solutions for diverse customer applications; (4) Supply chain reliability - consistent on-time delivery and responsive customer service; (5) Innovation focus - continuous R&D investment in emerging applications including humanoid robots, new energy vehicles, and smart home systems; (6) Manufacturing efficiency - advanced automation and self-designed equipment reducing costs while maintaining quality; (7) Comprehensive product portfolio - from basic gears to integrated intelligent drive systems serving multiple industries.
